question: At each retained contact geometry, could ALL passive rows' spring shifts together, each inside its achievable interval k_d*(range_d - q_d), satisfy the root-plus-passive subsystem? The per-row screen found no single row sufficient; this measures combined authority as one margin t.
hypothesis: If some saved witness yields t <= 1, the fixed-geometry conflict lies inside combined passive authority and a posture move along that direction is worth a physical trial; if every measured witness yields t > 1, the deficit is quantified in units of the achievable spring-shift box.
units: Native MuJoCo model units; the margin t is dimensionless (fraction of the achievable interval box)
controls: no physics is re-derived: only the saved support witnesses from the foot-placement and passive-posture experiments are replayed
the unchanged per-witness authority interval is the full closed joint range; tendon limits, friction, scaling and solver are byte-identical to the support LP
a witness whose margin LP is undecided is recorded as unresolved, never as a physical infeasibility
success_criterion: Every saved witness replays a decided margin LP; the recorded per-witness t and required shift vectors reproduce under re-solve; the aggregate outcome follows the declared rules.
falsification: t <= 1 on any witness rejects 'combined passive authority cannot cover this geometry'. t > 1 everywhere is a local statement about these saved geometries only: a different pose changes the contact map and bias, so this screen alone cannot rule out posture generation.

parameters.margin_variable: uniform scale t of every achievable passive spring shift interval k_d*(range_d - q_d); t<=1 means within combined authority at this fixed geometry
parameters.authority_interval: full closed joint interval, no inset
parameters.rows: six free-root equations plus every exactly-zero tendon-map row
parameters.solver: scipy linprog highs with the unchanged scaling and tolerances
parameters.inputs: saved foot-placement and passive-posture witnesses only; no physics
parameters.scope: fixed-geometry combined-authority screen; moving joints also moves contact geometry and bias, so margins are local to each saved pose
